method: Per-part bidirectional closest distances using all vertices, triangle centres, unique-edge midpoints and deterministic area-weighted surface samples (at least 250 per part). STEP tessellation requested at 0.001 mm deflection; all CAD faces are planes.
limitation: Agreement with the reconstructed GLB model, not physical venue accuracy. Sampled maxima are observations, not certified error bounds. Overlapping parts are retained separately; total volume is the sum of component volumes, not a union.
